title: Priority Ledger: Hybrid RICE+ Framework & Latency-Cost Sensitivity Model
creator: Priya Nambiar
description:
Goal: Create a repeatable, auditable prioritization ledger and scoring rubric that combines classic RICE with explicit operational sensitivity (latency impact) and unit-cost delta so roadmap ranking reflects both product value and production economics.

Background: We currently use RICE informally across PMs. This captures reach/impact/confidence/effort but misses two production-first dimensions that matter for Redwood: (1) Latency sensitivity (how customer-facing or SLO-critical a request is), and (2) Unit-cost delta (per-token and infra cost change). As we scale Dedicated/Private customers and emphasize cost-aware performance controls, we need prioritization that surface these trade-offs.

Proposal: Define a "RICE+" scoring model plus an attachable ledger (spreadsheet + lightweight JSON export) used for every roadmap candidate. Components: Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort (standard RICE) + LatencySensitivity (LS) + CostDelta (CD).

Scoring mechanics (proposal):
- Compute base RICE = (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort
- Normalize LS and CD to a 0-1 scale per rubric. LS higher means more latency-sensitive (increases priority); CD higher means larger cost increase (decreases priority).
- Combine: FinalScore = BaseRICE * (1 + w_ls * LS_norm - w_cd * CD_norm)
- Default weights: w_ls = 0.25, w_cd = 0.20. We will calibrate weights against historical decisions and a pilot of 30 backlog items.

Deliverables:
- Scoring template (Google Sheet + CSV/JSON export) with macros to compute normalized scores and final rank
- Public rubric doc describing how to score Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort, LS, CD with examples for common Redwood workstreams (runtime, console, dedicated)
- Integration plan for roadmap tool: CSV import mapping and a short script to attach scores to roadmap items
- Training session for PMs + one-pagers for engineering and design reviewers
- Pilot of 30 backlog items in Cycle 2026-W11, retrospective and weight recalibration

Acceptance criteria:
- Template + rubric published in Confluence and linked from roadmap board
- Pilot completed, weight calibration documented and applied
- >70% alignment between RICE+ top-10 and historical exec/PM top-10 for last quarter (measured by Kendall tau rank correlation target > 0.5)
- Integration script merged to infra-tools and one export/import example in roadmap board

Risks and trade-offs:
- Overfitting weights to a small pilot may skew decisions; mitigate by requiring quarterly recalibration and storing scoring history in the ledger.
- Puts more onus on PMs to estimate CostDelta; mitigate with templated cost-estimates from Finance/Infra and precomputed per-route unit-cost suggestions from ENG.
- Latency sensitivity is partly contextual; include guidance and binary flags (customer-facing SLO critical vs internal) to reduce subjectivity.

Next steps:
1) Finalize rubric draft with Eng + Finance by 2026-02-27.
2) Build scoring template and basic CSV export 2026-03-05.
3) Pilot scoring 30 items 2026-03-08 -> 2026-03-19.
4) Review pilot, publish docs, onboard PMs 2026-03-26.
